case_number: 2024 INSC 558; Writ Petition (C) No. 352 of 2023; With T.C.(C) No. 28 of 2023, T.C.(C) No. 29 of 2023, T.C.(C) No. 30 of 2023, T.P.(C) No. 2526 of 2023, T.P.(C) Nos. 2088-2089 of 2023
summary: Challenge to validity of State Bar Councils' (SBCs) enrolment fees; Section 24(1)(f) of Advocates Act prescribes fixed fee limits; fees beyond statutory limit ultra vires; miscellaneous charges cannot be pre-condition for enrolment; Article 14 violation due to manifest arbitrariness; Article 19(1)(g) unreasonableness; all fees at enrolment deemed 'enrolment fees'; SBCs restrained from charging beyond statutory limit.
final_judgment: SBCs directed to charge only enrolment fees prescribed under Section 24(1)(f); impugned fee practices declared invalid; miscellaneous charges struck down as pre-conditions for enrolment.
